checks.name: Exact served source bytes with no JavaScript/SRI faults

limitations: Isolated headless Linux Chromium at 320x640 and 390x844 using the existing exact-byte engineering fixture. No physical Android OS or screen-lock claim.
Service workers are blocked; this test does not validate SW update activation.
The existing fixture controls speech; this suite never starts audio and never reads personal recordings.
Screenshots are taken with the normal shipped visual CSS; no reduced-motion or style override is installed.

The existing noninteractive Esma neon aura may add up to 3px to internal tab scroll extent while remaining within the viewport. Raw internal extents, native control bounds and page overflow are checked separately.
